relationship_to_v13: P2 within-fixture matched selector comparison; v13 outputs are never modified or pooled into a new acquisition chain.

acquisition_arms.R: matched-random challenge from the common graph-private frontier
acquisition_arms.UQ: uncertainty-only challenge from the common graph-private frontier

common_frontier: unfinished targets with exactly one unfinished current-provider blocker, provider-eligible blocker, public achievement mask, and v13 pair-memory exclusions
R_rule: Sort the eligible common frontier by pair_key and select index floor(fixed_selector_uniform * n). The independent selector uniform stream is preregistered and not reused for provider selection.
UQ_rule: Select the eligible common-frontier candidate maximizing binary entropy of its current evidence-edge belief. Equivalently, minimize abs(p-0.5); use the fixed selector uniform only to break exact ties. It never reads decision impact, corruption labels, reference graph, correct order, or outcomes.
ES_rule: v13 counterfactual provider-decision-impact scorer, with the same common frontier and pair-memory rule.
randomness: Target and action uniforms remain paired across arms. R/UQ/ES selector tie/random uniforms use a distinct deterministic SeedSequence kind=31, so no selector consumes an ordinary-provider target draw.
freeze: All acquired graphs freeze before evaluation. Evaluation calls ordinary provider selection only: no challenge selection, graph update, or optimizer step.
